summary: Examples of with_subelements setting authorized SSH keys per user, creating MySQL users per host using a nested mysql.hosts key, and listing groups with skip_missing.
questions: How do I add all authorized keys for each user?
How do I create a MySQL user for every host listed under each user?
How do I loop over a nested key like mysql.hosts?

answer_card.title: with_subelements examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.posix.authorized_key:
    user: "{{ item.0.name }}"
    key: "{{ lookup('file', item.1) }}"
  with_subelements:
    - "{{ users }}"
    - authorized

- community.mysql.mysql_user:
    name: "{{ item.0.name }}"
    password: "{{ item.0.mysql.password }}"
    host: "{{ item.1 }}"
    priv: "{{ item.0.mysql.privs | join('/') }}"
  with_subelements:
    - "{{ users }}"
    - mysql.hosts

- ansible.builtin.debug: var=item
  loop: "{{ q('ansible.builtin.subelements', users, 'groups', {'skip_missing': True}) }}"
```
